text.comment: I'm so glad you could rejoin me. There is much I have to relay.
I must inform you of some very strange goings on.
The asteroid at the heart of this HQ does not seem to be an ordinary space rock.
Welcome my dear assistant! I am so grateful you were able to join me.
I must inform you of some very strange goings on.
The asteroid at the heart of this HQ does not seem to be an ordinary space rock.
Oh. Quite. Well, do please hurry back.
Well... to be brief... it is... emanating.
I shall have to study further, but there are distinct signals permeating through the structure.
I should jolly well think so!
Indeed. As far as I can tell, the asteroid is some sort of mineral-based... brain.
A brain of considerable power. And it seems to be reaching out.
Trying to connect with something.
That is an excellent question, assistant.
The signals seem to be reaching out in quite random directions. However, there is something else.

text.comment: The new sector you found, Mitsuno's Remembrance; something there seems to be signalling back.
I need you to investigate this further. Get to the bottom of this mystery, assistant.
Beyond Ianamus Zura, something seems to be signalling back.
I need you to investigate. By all accounts there should not be anything notable in that location.

add_player_choice.comment: The signals were sent by Kaori Chen.

text.comment: My goodness! That is astounding! This Kaori person must be in possession of some highly advanced technology.
You must bring her to me so that we can collaborate in more depth.
However, there is more to discuss.
Your abandoned vessel retrieval has certainly had an impact on the asteroid.
By parsing the telemetry through the asteroid brain, we were able to generate new research opportunities.
Please do be alert to any more such artefacts that could have a connection with the asteroid.
I mentioned that the mineral brain seems to be searching in all directions.
I have a theory that it seeks some kind of stimulus. As though it is... hungry.
Please do be alert to any artefacts you may encounter that could have a connection with the asteroid.

text.comment: I am so pleased that you returned. The Grandmother truly smiles on me this day.
I must inform you of some very strange goings on.
The asteroid at the heart of this HQ does not seem to be an ordinary space rock.
Thank you for visiting, stranger!
My friends will be envious of our meeting. A stranger in Remembrance!
I also have a mission for you, if you have interest.

add_player_choice.comment: I'm looking for a signal source.

text.comment: Leaving so soon? Do come back again. May the Grandmother smile on you, stranger.
We have been isolated for generations.
Mitsuno's Remembrance is a haven of peace and harmony. Blessed by the Grandmother.
Ah. The Grandmother founded our civilisation.
She is our saviour and the reason why we have enjoyed centuries of peace and prosperity.
Ah yes. The mission.
From our limited information, we understand that we have a different way of doing things here in Mitsuno's Remembrance.
We allow a form of barter. This can be for wares or even for ships.
I have been tasked with assessing whether outsiders can stomach barter as a way to make profits.
If you don't mind being my lab Argnu, I can send barter tasks to your mission interface.

text.comment: I do not know anything about strange signals.
Perhaps it is something to do with the Grandmother.
She is extremely clever and always up to some sort of experiment.
Ruler? Ha! No. Remembrance has no ruler. She is wisdom.
They say she sees the future.
Thank you again for rescuing young Kal.
The ship is very special. Built by the Grandmother herself.
She says it is a replica of one she flew many generations ago.
As a proven friend of the Quettanauts, I am happy to sell it to you.

text.comment: I am Gogoeolos Yahandis Yoyunis II, and my time is valuable. What is your requirement, traveller?
Such rudeness!
I shall return to more profitable tasks.
You say there is a Split trapped in a Ministry of Finance restricted zone? Very disturbing.
A new group of bandits after our profits, no doubt!

add_player_choice.comment: This could mean new trade opportunities.

text.comment: Hmmm. Profits. You make a good point.
Return to your Split friend and I shall have the minefield disarmed.
I do not have time for this. I have an important meeting to attend.
If you and your Split bandit friend are not gone by the time I emerge, you may find yourselves facing a Teladi battle fleet.

text.comment: Oh stranger. Shall we continue?
Hey there, stranger. It's good to meet you at last.
Thanks for rescuing Kal. She's a bit feisty, that one.
No problem. Come back when you have time.
Oh that. I gave up trying to stop people calling me that generations ago. I have literally never been fertilised and have zero grandchildren.
This body has never even had a womb!
Yes I'm very... very old. But, barring kinetic damage, kind of immortal. And you can call me Kaori.
In fact, please do not call me Grandmother.
Where to begin... I have to tell you a story.

text.comment: Hey, stranger.

add_player_choice.highlighted: if not $BosoTa? then true else false

text.comment: Hey, stranger.
Sure. Come find me when you want to pick this up again.
Ha! Yes - another gift from the Sohnen. In addition to an immortal synthetic body, the Sohnen gave us teleportation drives.
Just like this ship, the Xperimental Shuttle.
Although my drive has been fragged for a long time.
That was humanity's doing.
The Sohnen agenda spans the whole universe and all of time.
So they didn't pay attention to the simians evolving on Earth.
Then, out of nowhere, the simians miraculously created a Jump Gate.
I think the opening of the Earth Gate created a margin of error in their predictive algorithms that was intolerable to the Sohnen.
The missions were just a means to bring down that margin of error.
Of the thousands of Quettanauts, surprisingly few chose reality.
And of them, I think I'm the last.
The rest were lost or killed. At least, I haven't heard from any of the lost in a long while.
You detected my signals?

add_player_choice.comment: Boso Ta did. He's... a scientist.

text.comment: Holy frag! That's amazing!
I have been sending out signals with a Sohnen signature, in the hope of detecting a response from Sohnen tech.
If I can get my hands on Sohnen tech, I might be able to fix my teleportation drive.
Your scientist, Boso, may have the tech I need. You must escort me to him.
Actually, you might be able to help me with that.
You're an experienced and resourceful explorer. Perhaps you can keep an eye out for any Sohnen tech?
Let me know if you find anything likely. I'll be able to analyse it with my systems.

text.comment: Well well well! That Kaori Chen is a singular person, indeed!

add_player_choice.comment: What do you think about the Sohnen?

text.comment: While you are here, I do have other matters to discuss.
I had my suspicions that the asteroid at the heart of our HQ is no ordinary space rock.
Kaori has most definitely explained why this is the case.
Indeed. As far as I can tell, the asteroid is some sort of mineral-based... brain.
Your abandoned vessel retrieval has certainly had an impact on the asteroid.
By parsing the telemetry through the asteroid brain, we were able to generate new research opportunities.
Please do be alert to any more such artefacts that could have a connection with the asteroid.
I have a theory that it seeks some kind of stimulus. As though it is... hungry.
Please do be alert to any artefacts you may encounter that could have a connection with the asteroid.
We really have no way of knowing.
These beings are clearly far beyond our understanding.
Perhaps... just perhaps... they are the intelligence behind the gate technology itself.
I fear that joining the rest of the known galaxy may upset their peaceful equilibrium.
We should do what we can to assist them in this transition.

add_player_choice.comment: What do you think about the Sohnen?
